Subject: MAP draft + next steps (Redwood evaluation)

Samir —

Thanks again for a great discussion this morning. As promised, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the Redwood evaluation and summarized the key milestones below. Can you confirm the owners and target dates so we can align to your procurement timeline?

High-level milestones (draft):
- Pilot kickoff: Redwood tech review & infra onboarding — Target: 2027-05-16 — Owner: Eng lead
- Security review & questionnaire completion — Target: 2027-05-21 — Owner: Security owner
- Contract & commercial terms (SOW + pricing) — Target: 2027-05-28 — Owner: Legal / Procurement
- Pilot trial & success criteria validation (latency, cost per call, PII handling) — Target: 2027-06-18 — Owner: Eng lead / Customer SME
- Go/no-go decision and renewal/scale plan — Target: 2027-06-25 — Owner: Economic buyer

Draft RACI (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: Claire Huang (exec sponsor) — A
- Security owner: Samir Patel — R/C
- Legal owner: Procurement (procurement@finserve.com) / Legal counsel — C
- Eng lead: Marcus Lin (your infra lead) — R

Open dependencies:
- FinServe to provide SOC2 evidence and network whitelist info
- Legal to confirm data residency & IP terms
- Redwood to provide final pilot SOW and pricing for reserved capacity

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP grid + timeline), FinServe_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (security items we discussed)

Ask: Please reply with any edits to owners, dates, or missing stakeholders — if Marcus/Claire are not the right owners, list the names and emails and we’ll update the MAP. If procurement prefers a different procurement contact, include them in your reply.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Thanks Ben — helpful summary and nice to see the timeline. Quick confirmations and edits below.

- Economic buyer: Claire is correct (she asked to be looped).
- Security owner: I will own the security review and coordinate our security team for the SOC2 evidence. Expect completed questionnaire by 2027-05-18.
- Legal owner: procurement@finserve.com will coordinate with our legal counsel — please send the SOW + contract redline windows.
- Eng lead: Marcus Lin is the right person; I'll intro him in a follow-up email (he's OOO Tue-Wed but back Thursday).

A couple of notes:
- Can we move the pilot kickoff out by one week to 2027-05-23 — Marcus needs the extra week for environment prep and network approvals.
- Procurement asked if Redwood can provide a draft SOW and an indicative pricing sheet by 2027-05-10 so they can start internal review.

I'll follow up once Marcus is back and will add him to the thread.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of IT Security | FinServe Analytics
samir@finserve.com
